moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tr-clock, written here): Pie clip centred on the frame, from 12 o'clock clockwise, sweep 0 -> 360 deg over 700 ms easeInOutSine, radius past the far corner; incoming scene inside the pie, outgoing still underneath. Use a polygon clip with a fixed vertex count. HF showcase-mechanical ships a Clock Wipe (Apache-2.0). Params: duration (0.7 s) · start (12 giờ) · direction (thuận chiều kim).
